topics.label: 25. Rule 96: what every Indian label must show

questions.q: Which prefix does Rule 96 use for the batch number?
questions.why: Rule 96 prescribes the prefix.

questions.q: How much larger must the proper name be than the brand name?
questions.why: Since April 2019, at least two font sizes larger, brand name below or after.

questions.q: Which products are exempt from the proper-name size rule?
options: Vitamin FDCs and FDCs of three or more drugs
questions.why: Those FDCs are exempt.

questions.q: Which prefix goes before the manufacturing licence number?
questions.why: Rule 96 sets the prefix.

questions.q: What is the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 now called for drugs?
questions.why: The rules were renamed in 2023 when cosmetics moved to separate rules.

questions.q: How is the Schedule H caution printed since 2018?
options: A red vertical line on the left
Black type in a completely red rectangular box
questions.why: The red box replaced the red line.

questions.q: Which symbol goes on a Schedule X label?
questions.why: Schedule X uses XRx.

questions.q: Which sentence is added for Schedule H1?
options: It is dangerous to take this preparation except in accordance with the medical advice.
Keep out of reach of children.
questions.why: H1 adds this caution.

questions.q: A Schedule H drug that is a psychotropic substance carries which symbol?
questions.why: NDPS substances use NRx.

questions.q: Where does the schedule caution go?
options: On the innermost container label and every covering
questions.why: Every label layer carries it.

questions.q: Which statement opens a prescription drug’s package insert?
options: For the use of a Registered Medical Practitioner or a Hospital or a Laboratory only.
questions.why: CDSCO-approved inserts carry it.

questions.q: What does section 11 of the insert give?
options: The permission or licence number with its date
questions.why: Heading 11 is the permission or licence number with date.

questions.q: Which programme receives adverse reaction reports in India?
questions.why: PvPI is India’s national programme.

questions.q: Under which rules does CDSCO grant permission for a new drug?
options: New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019
questions.why: The NDCT Rules govern new drug permission.

questions.q: Can a company change the approved insert wording on its own?
questions.why: The insert must match the approved text.

questions.q: Since when have the top 300 brands carried a QR code?
questions.why: Schedule H2 applied from 1 August 2023.

questions.q: Which is not one of the Schedule H2 data elements?
questions.why: Price is not in the list.

questions.q: Where does the QR code go?
options: The primary package label, or the secondary label if the primary has no space
questions.why: Primary first, secondary if needed.

questions.q: From when are antimicrobials added to Schedule H2?
questions.why: Antimicrobials from 1 July 2028; vaccines, anti-cancer and NDPS drugs from 1 July 2027.

questions.q: What is planned to be added to the QR code?
questions.why: The Health Ministry announced it would add excipients.

questions.q: What words must follow the MRP?
questions.why: DPCO 2013 requires the MRP inclusive of all taxes.

questions.q: Does a strip sold on its own need an MRP?
options: Yes, it is the smallest retail pack
questions.why: The smallest pack offered for sale shows the MRP.

questions.q: Who fixes ceiling prices of scheduled formulations?
questions.why: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority.

questions.q: Which claim is not allowed on a label?
options: That it cures cancer, unless approved for it
questions.why: Schedule J lists diseases a drug may not claim to cure or prevent.

questions.q: The ceiling price is revised downwards. What changes on new packs?
questions.why: New packs carry the revised MRP.
